method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Act: Compilation No. 78, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 57, 2025 (C2026C00272, the Payday Super text); Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Regulations 2018: Compilation No. 8, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments F2026L00133 (register id F2026C00535). The compilation in force before 1 July 2026 is not deposited: paydays before that date return an explicit 'not answered' value, or take the old percentage as a labelled input; the formulas in ss 10A(5), 17A(2), 18C(1), 18D(2), 19A(2) from ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04402.formulas.md (transcribed by hand 21 October 2026 from the Word rendering of the same compilation)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Act s 6(1) (business day, usual period, extended usual period, ordinary time earnings, part-time employee), ss 10A(1)-(3), (5), (6), 12, 16A, 16B, 17A, 17B, 18C(1), (2) item 1, 18D, 19A, 19B, 20A(1), (2), 20C, 20D, 32C(1)(a), (1A), (1B), (2), (2A), 32CA, 32F(2), 32N(2), 32NA(1), (5), (11), 32Q; Regulations regs 11, 12(1)(a)-(c), (f), 13B-13D, 17A, 18(1), (2), 21(3) -- who is an employee, the under-18 part-time exclusion, qualifying earnings, the 12% charge percentage, the maximum contributions base (s 10A(5) formula; the ITAA 1997 cap an input), the due date (7 or 20 business days), shortfalls, notional earnings (s 19A, compounding daily; the GIC rate an input), the uplift and its reductions, the choice loading, which fund (chosen, stapled, default) and the standard choice form. Out: defined benefit schemes, eligible-contribution rules, out-of-cycle earnings, assessments, collection, penalties, the rest of Part 3A and Part 8, and the pre-1 July 2026 regime (not deposited)
seat: the employee (and the worker who may be one under s 12)
